description: Put type on a path (Type on a Path tool) or change its options (Type > Type on a Path > Options): effect (rainbow, skew, 3D ribbon, stair step, gravity), what part of the type aligns to which part of the path, spacing and flip. Works on rectangles, ovals, polygons, lines and frames; an item that already has type on its path is updated

alignTo.description: Align: which part of the type sits on the path

flip.description: Flip the type to the other side of the path

spacing.description: Spacing around sharp curves (InDesign's path spacing value)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

text.description: Text to put on the path (replaces existing path text)

toPath.description: To Path: top, centre or bottom of the stroke

name: apply_type_on_path
title: Apply Type On Path
